description: Procurement of Buses, Vans, Gully Bowsers and Tractors for the Department of Prisons
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The necessity for the supply of essential vehicle facilities to the Department of Prisons has arisen in order to carry out the relevant duties efficiently in directly engaging with the courts in relation to suspects in remand custody and accused sentenced by various courts in Sri Lanka and dealing with the welfare of those detainees. Accordingly, bids have been invited under the National Competitive Procurement Procedure for the purchase of 30 buses (44 seater), 10 buses (30 seater), 10 vans, 05 gully bowsers and 03 tractors for the Department of Prisons. 08 bidders have submitted bids for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to award the procurement for the purchase of vehicles for the Department of Prisons as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee pertaining to the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
